svg.title: Tensor-product flow: one time parameter survives

cc:Work.dc:title: Tensor-product flow: one time parameter survives
cc:Work.dc:description: Two unit circles are represented by a square with opposite edges identified. From A=(1/4,1/2), opposite motion by (t,-t), t=1/4, ends at B=(1/2,1/4) and keeps Q=3/4. First-factor motion by (s,0), s=1/4, ends at C=(1/2,1/2) and moves the quotient coordinate from 3/4 to0 clockwise. The residual flow has time s; the same-time diagonal has time2s, and the half-time diagonal restores time s. Straight dashed segments represent constant-Q fibers before edge identifications. The bounded-algebra assertion is proved in TF31–TF34; the drawing illustrates the equal-circle case.
